https://youtu.be/myDP6CaFyM8


Block based building system added.
The number of block has nothing to do with frame rate.
You can build more than 10,000 blocks.
The only matters is dynamic light source like lanterns. It drops much frame rate.



You can export your buildings so that bring old saved game buildings to new game. You can share your exported building file.



No more major update for a while because I have to ready to update main stories. It will take about 2 more months for translation, voice act record for scenario left.
If there is update, it will be described in below, not in new notice.

notes.title: update 190603 - pickaxe
notes.content:
https://youtu.be/6dVzoPP2DZQ


https://youtu.be/x_Lm6Le1y40




If you want to use old version save file, load your save game and than press [import landscape] button in system tab.





Trader sales tools and paints in productive housing menu.





Three system option added.

CPU thread dedicated to landscape loading - set this value 1/3 of your total thread. 
the more dedicated thread, the less frame drop when camera angle and location changed.


Landscape sight range - set this value 6 if you fulfill recommended PC spec.



VRAM useage - If you have low texture resolution problem, change this option. never set this value more than 80% of graffic card RAM








You can export landscape in system tab.
If you click that button, game remake LandscapeVoxel.sav file in save folder so that you can import landscape from old save file or upload to mod community.
Housings cant be exported for now. I will add that option about a month later.








昔のセーブファイルを使う為にはロードした後[import landscape]を押してください。ボタンはsystemにあります。

トレーダーが道具とペンキを売っています(buy productive housing)

CPU thread dedicated to landscape loading　-　自分のCPUスレッドの三分の一に設定してください。多いほどカメラが移動したときにプレーム落ちる時間を短くします


Landscape sight range　-　十分なCPUなら6に設定してください。
7にすると景色はいいですがよくプレームがゼロになります。
適用の為にはゲームを一度終了する必要が有ります。


VRAM useage -テキスチャー全体が単純になる問題が出来るとこの数字をいじってください。


systemの export landscapeボタンを押すとLandscapeVoxel.savファイルを作り直します。
このファイルを利用して新しいゲームに昔のセーブファイル地形をコピーしたり、他の人が作った地形をコピー出来ます

notes.title: Beta update 190530 - Mining crafting
notes.content:
https://youtu.be/x_Lm6Le1y40

If you use old save file, press [import landscape] button in system tab (never press export button first).


You can buy pickaxe and painters from trader- productive housing.

Don't dig too deeper because there is kill Z zone.

You can export landscape in system tab.
if you click that button, game remake LandscapeVoxel.sav file in save folder so that you can import landscape from old save file or upload to mod community.

Some castle gates are below the surface so you have to dig to enter village. this will be fixed in this weekend.
Civilians removed temporally.





When using pickaxe

Right click - dig

Right click + Shift - Inflate

Right click + Alt - Flatten

[N] key  -  toggle dig strength


   B key - let companion out of way



When using painter

Right click - paint

Right click + Shift - remove






This feature was planed for Girls' civilization 2.
But because current landscape streaming system takes too much VRAM and makes micro stuttering , it is applied to this title.

The game take 3GB of RAM when it starts.
Editing landscape takes RAM more and more up to 60% of your total RAM capacity.

notes.title: beta update 190521
notes.content:
This update is really big.



[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34066119/521c35f00b9870106a6c13d0eaa94a88c7c76ddb.png[/img]



Soldier tier upgrade system added.


You can buy only lowest tier soldiers.

Soldier item remember it's accumulated EXP.

You need both enough EXP and resources to update soldiers.

Soldier item get EXP after winning battle

Injured soldier has upgrade priority so that one upgrade heals one soldier.






Injury system added.

There is high chance to be injured not destoryed.

Injured soldier are not spawned in battle.

but it heals every day and night.

Equipped soldier heals faster.

I will add skill about healing speed and injury rate soon.

Intact soldiers have priority when being equipped.






Soldier Item never lose it's saved EXP and injured information even while being merged, splitted, moved , equipped.

When Soldier Item is splitted, it divides EXP and not injured soldier has priority.

When it's merged, it merge EXP and injured soldier number.





bug fix- generals not start battle while player is in castle.
weapon not ignores enemy now.
castle unloaded properly when move outside of village right after load saved game.

change - Unique general replenish speed become slower.



Old save file is compatible

notes.title: beta update 190514
notes.content:
This update may cause unexpected bug, crash.
And unlike other update, this will take about a week to become main branch.



Unique general system added. they never be removed unless they've lost all castle.
When they lose or have not enough soldiers, they go to closest castle which they own and manufacture soldiers.

This system allow unique general have own personality , quests and relationship. but details like these are not added yet.

Save file is compatible but old saves do not generate unique generals.
They don't have much function now anyway.


change- horse charge velocity decrease formula changed.

notes.content:
Wild animals added. 

Now even if you've lost everything by losing decisive battle, you can rise from scratch.

But you can not hunt them if you have many soldiers which slows down world map speed.



*Critical bug fix- Gunpowder age soldiers,items now shown properly.



Other patches listed below.



reward box does not tick timer when being interacted or player is in conversation,

you can expect 'retreat result'

all castle rewared box location and siege spawn location fixed except for chateaubriand.

soldier enemy detection radius become larger.

moon falls later.

Less EXP required for level up

New housing - small farm (produce some peji and wood)






Any player can access beta version through steam library.

Beta update will be applied as main update two days later with animal sound effect applied.
